articles.summary: GPS is an absolute national treasure. Highlighting the most pressing issues involving the nation’s reliance on GPS and the obstacles associated with that dependency, Federal News Network’s Eric White talked with NextNav’s Vice President of Regulatory Affairs Renee Gregory on its recent podcast episode: GPS has been revolutionary for everyone, but only when it is able to work.
articles.title: The Space Hour Podcast with NextNav’s Renee Gregory

articles.summary: “We congratulate Danielle Thumann Severs on her nomination to the FCC. As Senior Counsel to Chairman Carr, she brings a wealth of institutional, legal, and telecommunications expertise on a wide range of regulatory issues that will be invaluable to the Commission. We urge the Senate to move swiftly to confirm her."
articles.title: NextNav Statement on Nomination of Danielle Thumann Severs

articles.summary: NextNav, a leader in next-generation terrestrial Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) and 3D geolocation solutions, today announced Tiami Networks as a sensing ecosystem partner for 5G-powered counter unmanned aircraft system (UAS) detection solutions. The integrated sensing and communications (ISAC)-focused partnership between the companies will advance NextNav’s effort to leverage its 5G PNT Network to simultaneously deliver scalable long-range, wide-area sensing capabilities.
articles.title: NextNav and Tiami Networks Partner to Protect Against Unmanned Aircraft System Threats
